tickets.title: Print the run's cost in sail show's footer
tickets.description:
`sail show <run>` lists each call's cost but never the total. Add a footer line with the run's total cost.

## Acceptance criteria

- `sail show <run>` ends with `total $<cost>`, the sum of every call's cost, to two decimals
- A run with no agent calls prints `total $0.00`

tickets.title: Show the cost total
tickets.description: `sail show` should say what a run spent. Add the total of every call's cost at the end of its output.

comments.author: ivo
comments.body: Probably the same footer line FAKE-1 asks for.
